# Nexus 4K IPTV
Nexus 4K IPTV is a premium streaming service offering over 30,000 live channels, sports, movies, and series in 4K UHD quality. We provide buffer-free streaming, a dedicated 7-day catch-up feature, and comprehensive EPG (Electronic Program Guide) support.

## Key Information
- Official Website: https://nexus4ktv.pro
- Contact & Support: https://nexus4ktv.pro/contact
- Pricing Plans: https://nexus4ktv.pro/#pricing

## Technical Specs
- Resolution: HD, FHD, 4K, 8K support
- Uptime: 99.9% guarantee
- Channels: 30,000+ globally
- VOD: 70,000+ Movies & Series
- Features: Anti-freeze technology, VPN friendly, multi-device support.
